data.long_meaning: The name Maure is derived from the Latin word 'Maurus,' which originally meant 'dark-skinned' or 'Moor.' In ancient Rome, the term 'Maurus' was used to describe people from North Africa, particularly those of Berber or Moorish descent. The name Maure has been used in both male and female contexts throughout history. The name Maure carries the meaning “Moor, Dark-skinned” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin.
